Mahjongg Solitaire for the Newton, Version 2.1: GreyScale!Instructions ------------The goal of the game is to remove all of the tiles.  You can only removetiles that match each other - both number and design.  In addition theplant/flower tiles and the season tiles all match each other.  To removea pair of tiles, tap on them.  If they match, they will disappear, elsethe newton will ping at you.  Here's the trick: you can only tap ontiles that you can slide out to the left or right, and that are notunderneath another.  Think about the real game, (played with physicaltiles) you have to be able to remove the piece without disturbing anyothers.That's it.  In some ways, it's more of a soothing (?) exercise inmeditation than a game.Buttons and Stuff -----------------On the right side of the screen are a heap of buttons:UNDO: undoes the last move.  You can tap on this repeatedly to undomoves right up to a new board.  Note that it has to redraw the wholescreen, so it can be sluggish.HELP: highlights all available matching tiles.  This is a big ol' cheatkey, but I'm not good at the game, so I put it in.  Note that you willhave to tap on it AGAIN to continue playing.  If you already have a tileselected, hitting the help button will blink matching tiles.SAME: replay the same board.NEW: play a new board.  If you haven't registered Mahjongg, you can onlyplay five different board setups.  You'll quickly notice that the sameboards appear over and over.There is a tile counter to tell you how close you are to being done onthe top right of the screen.If you've got it set to display, an elapsed time counter will appear onthe bottom right side of the screen.The info button has an overview of the instructions (under help), andwill allow you to view stats (if they have been enabled in Prefs).Preferences -----------There are a couple of different preferences for this game, which can bemodified by looking under [i]->prefsWinnable Boards:  You can have the Newton only create games which can bewon.  Note that this doesn't guarantee that you will win, only that youcan't blame the Newton when you don't (:Show Timer:  This will cause there to be a tmier on the bottom rightside of the screen, showing you just how long you've been fighting thisparticular board.Keep Statistics:  Checking this box will cause the Newton to keep goreydetails on how long you've played Mahjongg and how often you've won. When the information on this screen becomes too embarrasing, you canreset it to zero.Payment -------Mahjongg is crippled shareware.  The original version was not crippled,and the response we got was poor enough to cause use to rethink ourdecision.The game is crippled by only allowing nonregistered users to play fivedifferent boards.  If you tap on New and get the same board, it islikely that the Newton created the identical board again.  Figuring theodds, this should happen about 20% of the time.  If you're happy playingthe same five boards over and over, don't bother to pay.  If you wantaccess to the gazillions of games that can be played, read on:There are several different ways to obtain a registered version ofMahjongg:1.  Purchase a registered copy from our publisher, Power Media, Inc. You can find their stuff at most computer stores that sell Newtons, oryou can contact them for information on the nearest retailer to you:1 503 684 8232http://www.powermedia.com2.  Register over the Web by visiting our website athttp://www.scrawlsoft.com 3.	Make a cheque out to "Scrawl, LLC" and send it to the followingaddress:Scrawl, LLC86 Norfolk St., Apt 4Cambridge, MA02139How much should you send us?  It depends how much you use it and enjoyit.  We suggest about $10.  If you're a real diehard Mahjongg junkie,then send more (say $20)!4.  If you already registered and earlier version of Mahjongg, you areentitled to the registration string for this version.  Just contact usathelp@scrawlsoft.comwith the details mentioned in the next section. Registration Information------------------------Be sure to include the spelling of your name as it appears on yourNewton in Owner Info.  If you use multiple Owner Cards, send the SerialNumber in Mahjongg's About Box.The registration string you receive will be keyed to the name or numberthat you send us, so please transcribe it accurately and legibly.Personal Tiles--------------I know that there will be people out there who want their own tiledesigns.  I can't spend time converting stuff back and forth until itwork, so I will only considering creating a custom tile set for you ifyou send me the information in EXACTLY the right form.  The easiestway to do this is to contact us athelp@scrawlsoft.comso we can send you the format of the tiles.  Then you can art them upto your hearts content.If you make a cool set of tiles, we may also bother you to let usdistribute them.  You'd then have fame, though no additional fortune.Legal Stuff-----------This Mahjongg for the Newton (v2.1) is Copyright 1997 by Scrawl, LLC,and was written by Sanjay Vakil and Brenda Carpenter. You are allowed tomake copies at will, and upload it to wherever you like, but you mustinclude this file, unmodified with it.  If you wish to distribute it viaa medium that requires payment (eg. CDROM Newton archive), you mustcontact us at the address above and send me a copy of the distribution.We're not to be held responsible for Mahjongg mucking up the data onyour newton, or for hours lost to Mahjongg when you could have beendoing something more productive.Fortunes are from real fortune cookie fortunes donated by members of theNewton Programmers' Collective.Mahjongg Revision History-------------------------2.1 Fixed several minor bugs with 2.0	- buttonbar on left works	- Added ReorientToScreen to Splash so bottom BB works right	- Undo Sounds added	- Timer starts and stops correctly with finished games	- Rotate works correctly at all times	- Added "Rotate" option to complaining intro screen	- Removed duplicate fortunes	- Added more fortunes2.0  Initial Release of GreyScale version1.5d Fixed bug that prevented minimization1.5c Public Release1.5b Public Beta Release	- added minimization capability	- added confirmation dialogs to the NEW and SAME buttons	- added additional HELP mode		- if a tile is tapped, hitting HELP flashes all matches	- added close button to the info screens	- fixed [i] button sibling bug	- fixed bug with playing a new game not clearing UNDO queue1.0  Initial release
